normal.name: LUAMA Emotional Universe
normal.text: MY OWN LIFE IS A GAME ENOUGH. Why would I want to live inside a video game when my own life is already a game enough? Life has its own challenges, unexpected turns, difficult levels, and missions without instructions. Sometimes you win, sometimes you lose, and sometimes you have to repeat a level until you learn your lesson. Honestly, I'm still trying to figure out this game called life. Why would I volunteer for another one? https://luamaseu6.wordpress.com/2026/11/11/my-own-life-is-a-game-enough/

normal.name: Mill&tea🦄
normal.text: Just tried Reka up to the first chapter and damn it's been a while since I've been this impressed. I love that the world is so immersive despite being so simple. The atmosphere is on-point for a witchy game. Although ngl they won me over when I realised you could have a familiar and just collect whatever random creature you ran into. Havent tried collecting the deer now I realised it, maybe I'll try if it lets me. Good game. I like it and am looking forward to future updates. #steamgames #rekagame #reka #games

normal.text: A Pizza Delivery (~2 hours) is a narrative game that handles mental health with care. Surreal world, real characters, no pressure. Like Journey turned inward. Left me thinking after credits. Recommended if you value honesty over mechanics. #APizzaDelivery #Steam
